verdict.rationale: Cursor's Run Modes docs say Auto-review sandboxes shell commands under file and network limits. Cloud Agents run in isolated VMs, and Self-Hosted Machines add network allowlists and private connectivity for tool execution. Worktrees and CLI permission tokens add file, shell and network-command scoping. Missing for 10: sandboxing applies only 'when it can' for local shell commands, with no evidence that MCP and other tool calls are sandboxed; details of sandbox configuration and network policy are thin; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
